Visitor replaces embedded iframe with custom text

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitIframe(NodeContext ctx, String src) {        return new VisitResult.Custom("[EMBEDDED: https://maps.example.com/embed]");    }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>Embedded map:</p><iframe src=\"https://maps.example.com/embed\" width=\"400\" height=\"300\"></iframe><p>End of map</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
